key.name: toggle-picker
key.summary: Open the theme picker

key.name: show-cheatsheet
key.summary: Show the keyboard shortcuts cheat sheet

key.name: toggle-stay-awake
key.summary: Stay awake on or off
key.description: Keeps the screen from dimming, locking and suspending until turned off (or the next login).

key.name: toggle-night-light
key.summary: Night light on or off

key.name: toggle-menu
key.summary: Open the Jade Menu

key.name: clipboard-history
key.summary: Keep a clipboard history
key.description: In memory only, never what password managers mark as secret.

key.name: toggle-clipboard
key.summary: Open the clipboard history

key.name: capture-card
key.summary: After a screenshot, a card with what to do next
key.description: Edit, copy its text, pin it on screen or show it in Files, in place of GNOME's banner.

key.name: pick-color
key.summary: Pick a color from the screen

key.name: capture-text
key.summary: Copy text from part of the screen

key.name: menu-capture
key.summary: Open the Jade Menu at Capture

key.name: menu-toggles
key.summary: Open the Jade Menu at Toggles

key.name: menu-system
key.summary: Open the Jade Menu at System
key.description: Super+Escape with the Omarchy keymap (GNOME uses it to give shortcuts back to an app that took them).

key.name: toggle-network
key.summary: Open the network panel

key.name: glass
key.summary: Solid panels, or frosted glass
key.description: Frosted: the top bar, menus, dialogs, banners and pop-ups blur what is behind them, tinted by the theme.

key.name: glass-tint
key.summary: How much of the theme's background frosted glass keeps (0.15 clear to 0.95 nearly solid)

key.name: glass-blur
key.summary: How strongly frosted glass blurs what is behind it

key.name: show-picker
key.summary: Show the theme picker in the top bar
key.description: The shortcut opens the picker either way.

key.name: show-workspaces
key.summary: Workspace buttons in place of Activities

key.name: show-clock-format
key.summary: Use the custom clock format

key.name: clock-format
key.summary: Clock format
key.description: A GLib.DateTime format, such as %A %H:%M for "Tuesday 14:05". Empty: the weekday and the time, 12- or 24-hour and with seconds or not as set in GNOME's Settings.

key.name: simple-calendar
key.summary: Calendar without world clocks and weather
key.description: Like Omarchy's clock panel: the date and the month only.

key.name: notification-bell
key.summary: Notifications behind a bell in the top bar
key.description: Like Omarchy's notification center: a panel of their own, with pop-ups at the top right. Off: GNOME's layout, beside the calendar.

key.name: bell-dot
key.summary: When the bell shows its dot
key.description: waiting: while notifications wait in its panel; unread: only for ones whose pop-up never showed (GNOME's rule).

key.name: bell-dismiss
key.summary: Dismiss the newest notification

key.name: bell-dismiss-all
key.summary: Dismiss all notifications

key.name: bell-toggle-dnd
key.summary: Turn Do Not Disturb on or off

key.name: bell-open-newest
key.summary: Open the newest notification

key.name: bell-show
key.summary: Open the notifications panel
key.description: Super+V opens it too.

key.name: start-on-desktop
key.summary: Start on the desktop instead of the overview

key.name: app-grid-columns
key.summary: App grid columns (0 for GNOME's choice)

key.name: app-grid-rows
key.summary: App grid rows (0 for GNOME's choice)

key.name: app-grid-icon-size
key.summary: App grid icon size in pixels (0 for GNOME's choice)

key.name: show-media
key.summary: Show what's playing in the top bar

key.name: show-weather
key.summary: Show the weather in the top bar
key.description: For the place chosen in the Jade Shell app (or GNOME's); nothing shows without one.

key.name: weather-location
key.summary: The weather's place: its name, latitude and longitude (degrees)
key.description: Chosen in the Jade Shell app. Empty: GNOME's weather place, if there is one.

key.name: weather-unit
key.summary: Temperature unit of the weather: default follows the language's

key.name: show-network
key.summary: Show the network in the top bar
key.description: An icon that opens the network panel (connection, speed test, DNS); GNOME's own network icon steps aside while it's on.

key.name: show-monitor
key.summary: Show the system monitor in the top bar

key.name: monitor-show-values
key.summary: Show CPU, memory, GPU and temperature as numbers in the top bar
key.description: Off: an icon that opens the monitor panel, measuring only while it is open.

key.name: monitor-gpu
key.summary: Include GPU usage
key.description: Not polled while the machine runs on battery, where polling would keep a discrete GPU awake.

key.name: left-alone
key.summary: Apps Jade Shell leaves alone
key.description: Target names (as in `jade apps`): theme switches, setup and the picker never change these apps' configs.

key.name: check-updates
key.summary: Check for new versions once a day
key.description: Asks the latest GitHub release for its version (a few bytes) and shows a notification when a newer one is out.

key.name: show-dock
key.summary: Jade's dock
key.description: A dock at the bottom of the screen, which is also the overview's dock. Off, GNOME's own dash is back in the overview.

key.name: dock-icon-size
key.summary: Dock icon size, in logical pixels

key.name: dock-magnification
key.summary: How large icons grow under the pointer
key.description: 1 turns magnification off.

key.name: dock-behavior
key.summary: When the dock hides
key.description: intellihide: when a window comes near it; autohide: whenever the pointer is not on it; always: never (windows keep clear of it).

key.name: dock-show-trash
key.summary: Show the trash in the dock

key.name: dock-icon-style
key.summary: Dock icons in their own colors, or tinted in the theme's

key.name: dock-genie
key.summary: Windows minimize into the dock with a genie effect
key.description: Off, GNOME's own shrink toward the icon.

key.name: dock-bounce
key.summary: Bounce icons as apps start and when they need attention

key.name: show-usage
key.summary: Show Claude and Codex usage in the top bar

key.name: usage-show-percentages
key.summary: Show provider names and percent used
key.description: When off, a single AI logo. Full usage remains in the menu.

key.name: usage-refresh-minutes
key.summary: Automatic usage refresh interval in minutes
